t: The Toupret Flexible Skimcoat Filler is a versatile solution for treating re-appearing cracks and light filling tasks. This fine skimcoat filler remains flexible when dry, ensuring a durable finish. It is suitable for damp areas, making it ideal for kitchens and bathrooms where breathability is essential. Ready to use straight from the tub, this white filler offers excellent adhesion on all substrates, including soft surfaces and for covering tiles. Its easy-to-spread and easy-to-sand properties ensure a smooth, professional result for various interior renovation projects.
